cases.name: Angela Marie Yount
cases.about: "She aspired to be the best mother she could possibly be and she loved her children more than anything else in this world. Shewas an avid animal lover and treated her pets the same as she would her family. She loved the outdoors, gardening, nature, the beach, & concerts.
